items.title: Keep Project Memory
items.description: Remember project decisions, gotchas, and preferences across sessions in plain Markdown files.
items.docs: Installs the project-memory skill. The agent keeps memories in .agents/memory/ and adds one line to AGENTS.md the first time it saves one. No hooks, background process, or database.
